identity_policy: Reuse this item for later updates; never create another item merely because a new local candidate is prepared.
verification_scope: Successful native submit callback plus online title, bilingual description, metadata tree hash, content byte count, tags, preview and visibility0. Not a remote per-file SHA download.
preparation_record_policy: This file is the current item identity and private-upload status. Immutable release manifests describe their freeze-time state; uploaded=false in a historical preparation record is not the current Steam item status.
